reports.title: Pfizer Reports Strong Third-Quarter 2026 Results And Raises 2026 Guidance

guidance.heading: 2026 FINANCIAL GUIDANCE(2)
section: ■Raises full-year 2026 Revenue guidance(2) by $1.5 billion at the midpoint to a range of $62.0 to $64.0 billion from $60.5 to $62.5 billion previously.
■Raises and narrows full-year 2026 Adjusted(3) diluted EPS guidance(2) to a range of $2.95 to $3.05 from $2.80 to $3.00 previously.

–Includes a one-time $650 million Acquired In-Process R&D charge related to the in-licensing and collaboration agreement with Innovent Biologics, Inc. recorded in the third quarter of 2026 with an unfavorable impact of approximately $0.10.
■The company’s guidance takes into consideration our strong year-to-date performance, continued confidence in our business and progress with ongoing cost improvement initiatives.

Revenues | $62.0 to $64.0 billion
Adjusted(3) SI&A Expenses | $12.5 to $13.5 billion
Adjusted(3) R&D Expenses | $10.8 to $11.8 billion
Effective Tax Rate on Adjusted(3) Income | Approximately 15.0%
Adjusted(3) Diluted EPS | $2.95 to $3.05
